params.subtitle: Q K V projections, scaled dot product, parallel heads

params.code:
q = self.q_proj(x).view(B, L, H, Dh).transpose(1, 2)
k = self.k_proj(x).view(B, L, H, Dh).transpose(1, 2)
v = self.v_proj(x).view(B, L, H, Dh).transpose(1, 2)

scores = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1) / math.sqrt(Dh)
attn   = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
ctx    = attn @ v

ctx = ctx.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(B, L, D)
return self.out_proj(ctx)

beats.caption: Forward pass: project, split heads, score, attend, merge

bullets: Each head learns a different relation pattern
Heads run in parallel — same compute, richer signal
Outputs concatenated, projected back to model dim
